evals.prompt: Adopt this existing research repository without moving its scripts or data, then prepare a resumable handoff.
evals.expected_output: Uses inspect and adopt, preserves the existing workflow layout, creates only the control layer, and records the next minimum action.

evals.prompt: Close this research session and prepare a reviewed Project2026 Notion portfolio payload without sending it.
evals.expected_output: Archives the handoff through a reviewed dry-run/apply flow and generates an immutable local Notion payload without writing to Notion.

evals.prompt: Pixi cannot solve my CUDA and PyPI dependencies. Fix pixi.toml for me.
evals.expected_output: Routes package solving to a Pixi environment workflow; Research Project OS is relevant only if the resulting environment state must be registered.

evals.prompt: Choose mitochondrial and gene-count QC thresholds for these single-cell samples and filter them.
evals.expected_output: Uses a domain QC workflow for threshold review and filtering; Research Project OS only records an approved decision or resulting evidence when requested.

evals.prompt: Run STARsolo for these GEO samples and repair the FASTQ read-role manifest.
evals.expected_output: Uses a specialized upstream data workflow rather than treating Research Project OS as the execution engine.

evals.prompt: Export this UMAP as editable PDF and high-resolution PNG for Illustrator.
evals.expected_output: Uses a scientific figure-export workflow; Research Project OS does not impose plotting backend, font, or export-format rules.

evals.prompt: Search PubMed for recent MDD single-nucleus studies and produce a source-grounded digest.
evals.expected_output: Uses a literature retrieval workflow; Research Project OS becomes relevant only when the search strategy or digest is registered as project evidence.
